scene.role: entry-level temporary vehicle-pedestrian traffic control intervention
scene.camera: high-oblique three-quarter view matching the locked G8-A construction map
scene.composition: one Korean construction-site traffic marshal standing beside a portable traffic barrier and a short pedestrian separation line; compact triangular footprint; equipment grounded on muddy/compacted temporary-road surface only through contact shadow, with no background plate
scene.marshal: adult construction worker in ordinary high-visibility vest, safety helmet and workwear, holding a traffic baton or giving a clear stop/slow hand signal; realistic proportions, not heroic poster pose
scene.barrier: portable construction traffic barrier with stable feet, believable site wear, no readable text
scene.separation: short modular pedestrian rail/delineator segment that clearly distinguishes the walking line from the vehicle lane
scene.lighting: dusk/night work lighting compatible with G8-A world, neutral warm work-light key with restrained cool ambient fill
scene.material: painted steel/plastic temporary works with realistic dirt, abrasion and contact shadow
scene.readability: marshal + barrier + separated pedestrian edge must remain recognizable when reduced to approximately 104x82 CSS pixels

mustRead: CONTROL means human traffic control, not an energy turret
one marshal is the primary identity
